metadata.title: Dental Sprint 2 Review Transcript
metadata.stakeholders: Jaden Cole; Dr. Minji Sohl; Benjiman Jennings
metadata.demo_effect: Provides the first high-value decision-rich transcript used by Ask and reporting.

payload.summary: Sprint 2 review shifted the program posture materially. The vendor delay became explicit, leadership directed the team to prioritize FHIR over feature work, and Dr. Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration
decisions.anchorText: FHIR migration work will take priority over all new feature work until the dependency risk is reduced.

decisions.label: defer three feature stories
decisions.anchorText: Three feature stories will be deferred to Sprint 3 so engineering effort can stay aligned to the critical path.

decisions.label: plan integration test harness
decisions.anchorText: Integration test harness work must be planned explicitly for Sprint 3 rather than assumed as hidden labor.

warnings: Dr. Minji Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.
Dr. Minji Sohl stated that approval of a schedule does not erase the environment risk.
